findings.text: follow-on: the figure caption misstates the achieved residual. It reads 'Maximum absolute residual 9.418e-10 Wb, i.e. 8.5e-7 of the reference peak'. A direct probe of the reviewed head (probe_residual.py) gives absolute residual 1.0418e-12 Wb and ratio 9.4175e-10 of peak 1.106280e-03 Wb. The caption takes the dimensionless RATIO (9.418e-10, the number the test prints as result['residual']) and relabels it as an absolute Wb value, then divides by the peak to get a second, spurious fraction (8.5e-7). The absolute residual is overstated by ~900x and the stated peak fraction is off by ~900x. The manifest and the test's emitted statement are internally consistent (ratio 9.418e-10); only the landed fragment caption is wrong. Impact: the evidence document a reader trusts states a residual ~three orders of magnitude worse than measured.

follow-on: the panel is drawn with the axis ON, contrary to the repository's binding figure rules ('No axes, no gridlines on 2D plots ... a poloidal panel is drawn with the axis off'; despine every axis). The SVG carries xtick_1..xtick_5 and ytick_1..ytick_9 groups, each with a real tick-mark path (e.g. line2d_1, a 6-unit stroke path) and a text label, plus axes spines (patch_2 onward). The fragment caption says 'One poloidal panel, line contours only'. The panel was not routed through nova.media (imas-ink), so set_axis_off() never ran. The reference/coil contours themselves are line contours (QuadContourSet, shared levels), which is correct; the furniture is the defect. Rule violated: nova AGENTS.md 'Plotting rules' and the global data-ink despine rule.

follow-on: resolve_validator_case retains an extra_layers keyword and the _layer_specs helper (lines 231-238) though no caller passes them (grep across nova/ and tests/ at head finds only the definition and its own use) and the coordinator's resume ruling said to 'drop the extra_layers workaround'. The landing line and the evidence fragment both assert 'no extra_layers workaround remains', which is true of the test but not of the module, which still ships the dead seam. Impact: a declared-dropped workaround persists as unused public surface, and the evidence overstates its removal.

justifications.durability: The guard is genuine and I falsified it: the 1.5x coil-current mutation raises the residual from 9.4e-10 to 0.438 of peak and turns the gate red (EXIT=1, reproduced). The converter is idempotent and that is tested (test_netcdf_to_hdf5_round_trips_a_layer asserts master.h5 mtime unchanged on a second call). The gate is committed and runs without the registry skip path in this environment. Deficiencies: the bound (1e-3) sits six orders above the achieved residual (9.4e-10), so the gate is loose, but the control shows it still discriminates a real fault; a retained dead parameter (finding 3); and the figure/caption defects under evidence.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced in a scratch tree extracted from the reviewed head (git archive 5ae3ec946 -> $TMPDIR scratch, module.__file__ confirming the scratch copy; log review-head-gate.log): the gate as a fresh process gives 5 passed, EXIT=0, matching the reviewed manifest's headline (analytic-smoke-head.log, 5 passed). Direct probe (probe_residual.py) confirms the head residual: absolute 1.0418e-12 Wb, ratio 9.4175e-10 of peak 1.106280e-03 Wb. Gaps: (a) the reviewed head log carries no revision/tree/command header (its first line is pytest progress dots), so a reader cannot tell what it measured; (b) the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite are both null, so the designed base-vs-head delta reads no log; (c) the evidence fragment's figure caption misstates the residual (finding 1) and the figure draws axes/ticks contrary to the media rules (finding 2).
justifications.fit: ValidatorCase/ValidatorLayer are dataclasses with a matching error hierarchy (ValidatorCaseError) and a typed __all__, imas is TYPE_CHECKING-guarded, and no plan/sprint/version label appears in any name or comment; the test keeps the suite's docstring-first idiom. One idiom deviation: the figure under docs/figures/forward-profile-validator-set/fpv-analytic-smoke does not route through nova.media (imas-ink) and is drawn with the axis on (xtick/ytick groups and spines present), contrary to the repository's binding rule that a poloidal panel is drawn with the axis off and despined (finding 2).
